confirmed: nw_mainline_pending is a TX predicate and omits ui.operation/radio.pending/scan_ack_pending. A separate locked UI predicate is required; changing the TX predicate would break TX/shutdown loops.
Wake generation was sampled after nw_wifi_step; a wake in that step could be lost before the sleep decision.
nw_wifi_step ran potentially synchronous lx_pump before dispatching mainline UI. Dispatch is now before pump.
Repeated ready work used yield-only after2ms. It now actually blocks1ms, while pending IRQ/control wake still interrupts the wait.
Idle disconnect with no pending/join/scan and state below AUTH previously queued dev_close/dev_open. It is now a no-op only in that precise idle case.
